title: Screenshot
captureFailed: Couldn't take the screenshot. Check the screen recording permission and try again.
studioHint: Drag around the screenshot to turn the camera and scroll to zoom. Hold Space and drag to move the screenshot, or Space and scroll to bring it closer or push it back. Drag the small light to change where the light comes from.
studioUnavailable: Studio looks need WebGL 2, which isn't available here.
studioGestures: Click to focus · Drag to turn · Scroll to zoom · Space + drag to move · Drag the sun to relight
focusRingTitle: Drag onto what should be sharp. Scroll to widen the sharp area. Double-click for automatic focus.
lightHandleTitle: Drag to move the light. Scroll to make it brighter or dimmer. Double-click to reset it.
